# Marketics

> Performance-based short-term rental (STR) optimization for Airbnb and VRBO hosts. ~42% portfolio benchmark revenue increase across 30 documented listings; every property is audited individually before a target is set. 10% of bookings, no monthly fee, no contract.

Marketics is a performance-based short-term rental optimization company that combines dynamic pricing, listing optimization, automated guest communication, market analytics, and marketing into a managed offering for Airbnb and VRBO hosts. Founded in 2023 by Jason Baxter, a 35× Airbnb Superhost with 10+ years in the vacation rental industry and 1,000+ properties optimized across North America. Headquarters: 1000 Brickell Avenue, Suite 715, Miami, FL 33131. Service area: United States, Canada, Mexico (22 active markets).

## What Marketics Does

A fully managed revenue optimization service for short-term rental owners and property managers:

- **Dynamic pricing optimization**: rate management calibrated to local demand, events, seasonality, and competitor positioning to maximize RevPAR (revenue per available room).
- **Listing creation and optimization**: professional copy, photography guidance, and platform SEO for Airbnb, VRBO, and direct booking channels.
- **Automated guest communication**: templated and AI-assisted messaging for pre-arrival, mid-stay, and post-checkout.
- **Market analysis**: pre-investment analytics, comp analysis, event-demand mapping, and market selection guidance.
- **Marketing services**: Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn, and direct booking funnels for portfolios scaling up.

## Pricing & Refund

Marketics charges 10% of net booking revenue per property. No setup fees beyond a one-time $500 onboarding fee, which is **fully refundable on completing the 90-day program, with no performance condition**. No monthly retainers, no long-term contracts. The model is performance-based: Marketics only earns when the host earns.

## Key Results (Methodology)

All statistics reflect Marketics-managed properties. Sample: 30 documented listings across 22 markets. Measurement period: first 90 days post-audit completion. Baseline: host-reported revenue for the 90 days immediately prior to engagement.

- Across 30 documented listings, the portfolio benchmark is a ~42% increase in monthly revenue. Results are property-specific, so every property is audited individually before a target is set; we don't quote a number on a listing we haven't seen. Because the fee is 10% of bookings with no monthly fee, the large majority of any gain stays with the host.
- Average time to measurable results: 72 days from audit completion.
- Average guest rating post-optimization: 4.93★ (up from ~4.3 before).

## About the Founder

Jason Baxter is a 35× Airbnb Superhost and the founder of Marketics. He has built, managed, and optimized 1,000+ short-term rental listings across North America over the past decade, combining hands-on hosting experience with data-driven pricing strategy, platform-algorithm expertise, and marketing automation. He is based in Miami, Florida.
